• The onboarding guide is in docs/onboarding.md. It has three parts:

  1. Setup: clone, install the toolchain with mise, run the tests.
  2. The release process, from a tagged commit to the changelog.
  3. Who to ask about the API, the web app and the infra.

  I left out the on-call rota; docs/oncall.md already covers it.
